title: Glowing headphones
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- headband -->
  <path d='M22 58 C22 26 78 26 78 58' fill='none' stroke='#37e6ff' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M30 54 C32 36 68 36 70 54' fill='none' stroke='#b8f6ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='22' cy='63' rx='12' ry='15' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='63' rx='7' ry='9.5' fill='#ffd0e6'/>
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='63' rx='3.4' ry='4.6' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <!-- right ear cup -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='63' rx='12' ry='15' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='63' rx='7' ry='9.5' fill='#ffd0e6'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='63' rx='3.4' ry='4.6' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <!-- cushion glow accents -->
  <path d='M14 55 Q11 63 14 71' fill='none' stroke='#ffe66b' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M86 55 Q89 63 86 71' fill='none' stroke='#ffe66b' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
